study_design: Age-matched case-control study of prevalent prostate cancer
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Two hundred patients and 200 age-matched controls (+/-5 y) were selected from 3 geographic areas of Japan.
reason: The abstract examines the prevalence of prostate cancer in a case-control study. It does not analyze an aggressive incident prostate cancer endpoint.
